Both historical selection portraits remain complete.

Leonard Wolf SH3 faces the opponent in both slots. His head, two pointed arms including both tips, legs and both feet are complete. The floor alignment is effectively exact, with the lowest visible pixels 0.003 px below the ground. The hidden brown RGB background is absent from the real Canvas render: no visible rectangle or material alpha halo. Both historical selection portraits remain complete.

limits: Actual FightEngine with native Canvas, not browser screenshots. DOM, CSS, browser input, browser decoding and service worker behavior are outside this review.
Static one-frame idle candidates. Introductions, 120 idle updates, rendering and pause do not certify bitmap animation, new attacks or collision timing.

Opposite facing uses the engine mirror. Neither independently established rear anatomy nor source fidelity 1:1 is certified. The slightly oblique lateral poses are recomposed from their exact-edition source references.
Both final combat captures and all four historical selection portrait captures were manually inspected. The two tick0 captures are recorded but are not counted as manual visual inspections.
This run and its reports belong only to the complement. No first-batch reports were changed.
